title: Transient analysis observation (draft v0.1)
description: One measured-or-inferred observation about a learner turn, transient by default. Status: DRAFT v0.1 — not frozen; no disfluency algorithm is chosen in Phase 01. Rules encoded here: status=available means value and unit are present, and value 0 is a real measured zero (for example, zero fillers); status=unavailable or insufficient_evidence means value is null — 'no fillers were measurable' must never be reported as zero or as a clean fluency bill. source separates `measured` (derived from the learner's own audio by a stated method) from `inferred` (a model's judgment), so inferred claims are never presented as measurements. Transcription confidence is not a speaking score and has no place in this shape.

metricKey.description: Draft metric allowlist; frozen in Phase 03.

source.description: measured = derived from learner audio by the stated method; inferred = model judgment over audio/transcript evidence.

status.description: available = a numeric value exists (0 is a value). unavailable = the signal could not be measured at all. insufficient_evidence = there was not enough speech to compute the metric.

value.description: The measured or inferred value. null exactly when status is not `available`.

unit.description: Unit of `value`; null exactly when status is not `available`.

evidenceSpan.description: Where in the learner's own audio this observation is anchored, on the learner-audio sample clock. Null when the metric is not audio-localized. These are estimated boundaries, not word timings.

limitations.description: Plain-word known limitations, e.g. 'estimated from speech-region detection; filler recognition not validated'.
